Definition: an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol
BiblicalUsage: The word ʼEshtâʼulîy covers an Eshtaolite or inhabitant of Eshtaol. It occurs just once, in 1 Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼEshtâʼulîy is best left as Scripture leaves it: Eshtaolite or inhabitant of Eshtaol.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
